metadata.title: Card Break Platform
metadata.description: Hong Kong card break platform — pick team/player slots, pay securely, choose shipping after the live reveal.

auth.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid international phone number starting with + (e.g. +85291234567)
auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to lock a slot and complete payment
auth.signupSubtitle: Email and international phone are required for SF Express shipping and FPS payouts
auth.confirmEmail: Check your inbox and click the confirmation link to finish signing up.
auth.callbackError: The sign-in link expired or failed. Please log in again.

account.title: My Account
account.subtitle: View your profile and wallet balance
account.walletNote: If a break is cancelled, 100% of what you paid is credited to your on-site wallet (no Stripe refund). You can spend wallet credit at checkout — full credit checkout has zero gateway fees.

walletHistory.title: Wallet history
walletHistory.subtitle: Browse and filter wallet transactions from the past 24 months.
walletHistory.loadError: Could not load wallet history. Please try again.

withdrawals.title: Request cash out
withdrawals.subtitle: Withdraw wallet credit via FPS, PayMe, or PayPal. Funds are deducted immediately and held until admin approval.
withdrawals.historySubtitle: Track pending, completed, and rejected requests.
withdrawals.submitSuccess: Cash out request submitted. Your balance has been reserved pending admin approval.
withdrawals.cancelConfirm: Cancel this pending cash out request? The amount will be returned to your wallet.
withdrawals.cancelSuccess: Cash out request cancelled. Credit restored to your wallet.
withdrawals.cancelError: Could not cancel this request. Please try again.

methodHints.FPS: Enter your FPS phone number or FPS ID.
methodHints.PayMe: Enter your PayMe mobile number or payment link.
methodHints.PayPal: Enter the PayPal email address to receive the payout.

errors.RATE_LIMIT: Too many requests. Please wait before submitting again.
errors.UNKNOWN: Could not submit your request. Please try again.

account.phaseNote: Phase 6: on-site wallet and cancellation credits are live.

breaks.listSubtitle: Pick a team or player slot. Checkout holds the slot for 8 minutes.
breaks.featuredSubtitle: Active listings loaded from your database
breaks.slotsSubtitle: Available slots can be checked out. Sold or locked slots cannot be purchased.
breaks.addToCartError: Could not add to cart. Please try again.

addToCartErrors.lockedByOther: This slot is locked by another buyer.
addToCartErrors.unavailable: This slot is not available right now.
addToCartErrors.alreadyInCart: This slot is already in your cart.
addToCartErrors.breakInactive: This break is no longer active.
addToCartErrors.cartExpired: Your cart timer expired. Refresh and try again.
addToCartErrors.lockExpired: The slot lock expired. Refresh and try again.
addToCartErrors.migrationRequired: Cart is not set up yet. Run the Phase 8 database migration.
addToCartErrors.walletCleanupFailed: Could not update wallet state. Please try again or contact support.

checkout.buyNowSubtitle: This flow is isolated from your cart. Complete payment within 1 minute.
checkout.buyNowTimerHint: This slot is held for 1 minute. It releases automatically when time runs out.
checkout.title: Your slot is locked
checkout.subtitle: Complete payment before the timer expires. Use wallet credit, Stripe, or both.
checkout.noWalletCredit: You have no wallet credit yet. Payment will go through Stripe.
checkout.payError: Could not start payment. Make sure your lock is still active and try again.
checkout.payHint: Cards · Apple Pay · Google Pay supported via Stripe
checkout.creditOnlyHint: Paid fully with wallet credit — no Stripe gateway fees.

paymentErrors.CREDIT_EXCEEDS_PRICE: Credit cannot exceed the slot price.
paymentErrors.LOCK_EXPIRED: Your lock expired. Go back and pick a slot again.
paymentErrors.SLOT_UNAVAILABLE: This slot is not available for purchase.
paymentErrors.CART_EXPIRED: Your cart timer expired. Add slots again to continue.

checkout.lockActive: This slot is reserved for you for 1 minute. It releases automatically when the timer ends.
checkout.lockExpired: The lock expired and the slot was released. Go back and pick a slot again.
checkout.phaseNote: Phase 6: wallet credit, mixed checkout, and cancellation refunds are live.

success.title: Payment successful!
success.subtitle: Your slot is confirmed. After the live break, choose shipping from your account.

failed.title: Payment not completed
failed.default: Payment was cancelled or timed out. Holds were released and wallet credit restored (if any).
failed.timeout: Payment timed out. The slot was released — please try again.
failed.cancelled: You cancelled payment. The hold was released.
failed.buyNowNote: Buy Now failure does not affect items in your cart.
failed.cartNote: Other cart items remain held until the cart timer expires.

errors.title: Could not lock this slot
errors.SLOT_LOCKED_BY_OTHER: Another customer is checking out this slot. Pick a different one or try again later.
errors.SLOT_ALREADY_SOLD: This slot is already sold. Please choose another one.
errors.BREAK_NOT_ACTIVE: This break is no longer active.
errors.SLOT_NOT_FOUND: This slot could not be found.
errors.SLOT_UNAVAILABLE: This slot is not available for purchase.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.

cart.title: Shopping cart
cart.subtitle: Check out multiple slots in one payment. All items share one 5-minute timer.
cart.timerActive: New items sync to this remaining time (the 5-minute timer does not reset).
cart.timerExpired: Cart expired. All slots were released.
cart.paymentWarning: ⚠️ After you click pay, your slots are held for 5 minutes — please complete payment promptly.
cart.cancelNotice: Payment was cancelled. Your cart items are still held — you can retry checkout before the timer expires.
cart.expiredNotice: Your cart session timed out while payment was in progress. All slots were released and wallet credit was restored.

addModal.title: Added to cart
addModal.subtitle: This slot is locked and added to your cart.

admin.dashboardSubtitle: Create and manage card break events
admin.newBreakSubtitle: Add an event and team/player slots
admin.descriptionPlaceholder: 30-team break · Live on Instagram · Shipping after break
admin.slotsHint: One slot per line: Name,Price (e.g. Lakers,300)
admin.cancelBreakConfirm: Cancel "{title}"? All paid orders will be refunded 100% to user wallets (no Stripe refund).
admin.cancelBreakSuccess: Break cancelled. Refunded {count} order(s) to user wallets.
admin.cancelBreakError: Could not cancel this break. Please try again.

withdrawals.title: Withdrawal requests
withdrawals.subtitle: Review pending cash out requests, pay users offline, then complete or reject.
withdrawals.pendingSubtitle: Transfer cash manually, then mark complete or reject if details are wrong.
withdrawals.completeConfirm: Mark {amount} as paid and complete this withdrawal?
withdrawals.rejectConfirm: Reject this {amount} withdrawal and restore credit to the user's wallet?
withdrawals.rejectSuccess: Withdrawal rejected. Credit restored to user wallet.
withdrawals.actionError: Could not update this withdrawal. Please try again.

home.headline: Clean, fast, secure breaks
home.subheadline: Browse active breaks and claim your favourite team or player slot. Pay securely, watch the live reveal, then choose SF Express collect-on-delivery, pickup, or international shipping from your account.
home.phaseNote: Phase 4 complete: 8-minute slot lock. Next: Phase 5 Stripe payments.

footer.tagline: Built for HK and international collectors
